title: Clumsy Factorial
description: Calculate the clumsy factorial of n where operations follow (*, /, +, -) in sequence.
pseudocode:
1: stack.push(n)
2: op = 0
3: for i from n-1 down to 1:
4:   if op == 0: stack.push(stack.pop() * i)
5:   else if op == 1: stack.push(Math.floor(stack.pop() / i))
6:   else if op == 2: stack.push(i)
7:   else: stack.push(-i)
8:   op = (op + 1) % 4
9: return stack.reduce((a, b) => a + b)
